name: WorkID og-image — verified hiring marketplace card by WorkID.ai
description: A 1200×630 social card that compresses an entire landing page into one frame. A centred blue rounded-square app icon with the wordmark anchors the top, two tilted white job-listing cards crop off the left and right edges to imply a live marketplace, and the focal point is the bold two-line headline 'Only verified employers. Only real candidates.' set in near-black geometric sans. Below it, a compact pill search bar, four pale-blue category tiles and cropped listing rows add product density over an ice-blue gradient, with mint 'New' tags and soft shadows providing the only extra colour.
